text: Give the gift of wise rule to the king, O God, the gift of just rule to the crown prince.
be honorable to your meek and lowly.
shape the hills with the contours of right living.
help the children of the needy, come down hard on the cruel tyrants.
age after age after age.
earth-refreshing rain showers.
and peace abound until the moon fades to nothing.
from the River to the Rim.
his enemies lick the dust.
kings rich and resplendent will turn over their wealth.
and godless nations sign up to serve him,
the destitute who have run out of luck.
he restores the wretched of the earth.
when they bleed, he bleeds; when they die, he dies.
Deck him out in Sheba gold. Offer prayers unceasing to him, bless him from morning to night.
cresting the mountains in wild exuberance, Cornucopias of praise, praises springing from the city like grass from the earth.
his fame shine on like sunshine. May all godless people enter his circle of blessing and bless the One who blessed them.
the one and only wonder-working God!
All earth brims with his glory.
Yes and Yes and Yes.
